comparison.objective: Release a terminal from a housing, versus snap a PCB from a scored panel and tray it.
comparison.physical_skill: Localized latch defeat and controlled pull, versus supported bending/fracture along a registered break edge and subsequent placement.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal and housing remain intact with neighbors retained; versus a valid score-line break and separated board placed in the tray.
comparison.reason: The record intentionally performs controlled fracture, whereas the candidate forbids damage and releases a latch.
